name: Eightify
tagline: AI YouTube summarizer that turns any video into key takeaways and timestamps.
description: Eightify is an AI summarizer for YouTube, delivered as a browser extension with companion mobile apps. It condenses a video into key insights, a short overview, and timestamped sections so you can grasp the main points in seconds and jump straight to what matters, with summaries and translations in 40+ languages. Summaries are generated using ChatGPT and Claude, and it handles videos up to several hours long.
insight: Summaries run on both Claude and ChatGPT, and a single account works across its Chrome extension and native iOS and Android apps.

modelSupport.notes: Summaries are generated with Claude and ChatGPT.

edge: Purpose-built for YouTube: one extension (plus iOS/Android apps on the same account) that delivers timestamped, multi-language video summaries in seconds.
pros: Works on Chrome, iOS, and Android
cons: Free tier limited to a few summaries
